{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
# (note: only baseline has -999.0; final has no such sentinel)
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)
df['biomarker_final'] = df['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check for any remaining -999.0 values
df[['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].eq(-999.0).sum()"}
